name: io.github.huangdun/tempmd
description: Publish artifacts to one stable public temp.md link that updates in place. No account needed.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer followed by a temp.md account API key for account-owned publishing and account tools

environmentVariables.name: TEMPMD_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the temp.md API base URL (default: https://api.temp.md)
